word: A noisy blender roars across the counter.

word: A greasy rag slips from my hand.
answer: Un trapo grasoso se resbala de mi mano.

word: A peaceful hum fills the empty diner.
answer: Un zumbido pacífico llena el comedor vacío.

word: A smelly bucket sits near the sink.
answer: Una cubeta apestosa está cerca del fregadero.

word: A gentle mop glides across the tiles.
answer: Un trapeador suave se desliza sobre los azulejos.

word: I am going to scrub the tasteless stains.
answer: Voy a tallar las manchas insípidas.

word: A loud thud echoes from the pantry.

word: A weak bulb flickers above the doorway.

word: A dangerous puddle spreads under the fridge.

word: We are going to dry the colorless spill.

word: A silent worry grows in my chest.

word: A flavorful aroma drifts from leftover soup.
answer: Un aroma sabroso flota de la sopa sobrante.

word: We are going to calm the aggressive customer.
answer: Vamos a calmar al cliente agresivo.

word: A powerful draft pushes open the door.
answer: Una corriente poderosa empuja la puerta.

answer: Voy a terminar esto silenciosamente.
